summary: Frontend-only testing of jobs.php rebuild + auth modal narrow-viewport CSS fix + regression. All structural/interaction requirements for jobs.php pass and the auth modal is fully contained on 380/500/1920 viewports. One integration issue found: /api/get-cities.php returns 404 in this preview because ingress routes /api/* to the FastAPI backend (port 8001) instead of the PHP server (port 3000), so the city dropdown does not populate.

integration_issues.flow: Category sidebar city dropdown load (jobs.php and category.php?module=jobs)
integration_issues.issue: GET /api/get-cities.php?country_id=1 returns 404 (FastAPI 'Not Found' JSON). The Kubernetes ingress routes any /api/* path to the FastAPI service on :8001, so the PHP script at /app/site/api/get-cities.php is unreachable via this URL from the preview domain. As a result, after selecting Hollanda the city select is enabled but only contains the 'Şehir' placeholder (0 real city options). A console/network error is produced. Spec required '>0 options via /api/get-cities.php (no console errors)'.

action_items: Fix /api/get-cities.php loading in the preview environment. Options: (a) change base_url path in /app/site/assets/js/category-filters.js and /app/site/pages/post-vehicle.php from '/api/get-cities.php' to a non-/api path served by the PHP app (e.g. '/ajax/get-cities.php' or '/get-cities.php'), OR (b) configure ingress to send /api/*.php to the PHP backend (port 3000) while keeping /api/* JSON routes on 8001. Without this, the sidebar city select on the new jobs.php (and category.php) cannot list cities.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/site/assets/js/category-filters.js relies on '/api/get-cities.php' which collides with the ingress /api -> FastAPI routing on this deployment topology. Prefer a PHP-owned URL prefix (e.g. /ajax/…) for internal PHP AJAX endpoints to avoid ambiguous routing.

success_rate.frontend: 88% (7/8 checks fully green; 1 partial due to /api routing conflict)

context_for_next_testing_agent: jobs.php structural + AJAX-no-reload + auth-modal-narrow-viewport tests all pass. The only failing requirement is city dropdown population because /api/get-cities.php resolves to FastAPI (404) in the preview. This is an infra/routing conflict, not a jobs.php-specific bug — it will also affect any other PHP page using category-filters.js. Iteration_2 did not exercise the get-cities XHR so this went unnoticed. When retesting after main-agent fix, verify /api/get-cities.php?country_id=1 returns a JSON array and that selecting Hollanda populates >0 city options with no console errors.
rca of the issue: Root cause: The frontend JS (/app/site/assets/js/category-filters.js line 12) calls fetch(base + '/api/get-cities.php?...') where base='' (site brand href is '/'), producing an absolute-path request to /api/get-cities.php on the preview origin. The Kubernetes ingress in this environment forwards every '/api/*' request to the FastAPI service on port 8001; the FastAPI app has no such route and returns HTTP 404 with body {"detail":"Not Found"}. The PHP file physically exists at /app/site/api/get-cities.php but is only reachable via the PHP server on :3000 for non-/api paths. Reproduction: open /pages/jobs.php, select country 'Hollanda' (value=1); DevTools Network shows /api/get-cities.php?country_id=1 -> 404; city select stays at only 'Şehir' placeholder. Mitigation: either change the JS/PHP callers to use a non-/api path (e.g. /ajax/get-cities.php) served by PHP, or add an ingress rewrite mapping /api/*.php to the PHP backend.
